connect_pyworld_mover: connect to a Minecraft world server using PyWorldMover with a custom port and IP address
dig_place_blocks: use PyWorldMover to dig blocks at coordinates and place blocks in the Minecraft world
query_world_blocks: query a rectangular region of blocks from the Minecraft world using PyWorldMover get_blocks
move_agent_in_world: move the Minecraft agent in any direction using PyWorldMover step methods like step_pos_x or step_forward
query_entities_and_inventory: query players, mobs, item stacks, and inventory from the Minecraft world using PyWorldMover
